tool_config.name: save_hws_enquiry
tool_config.description: Save a confirmed, consented enquiry into the HWS team inbox. Ask one field at a time, read back the details and get consent first. A retry or correction within this call updates the same enquiry. Say saved only if response.saved is true. This does not book a callback time or make a transfer.

phone.description: Confirmed callback phone; empty string if caller provided email instead.

email.description: Confirmed callback email; empty string if caller provided phone instead.

postcode.description: Confirmed postcode if relevant, otherwise empty string.

summary.description: Concise enquiry, exact product references, quantities and measurements with units. Apply all caller corrections; no invented facts.

confirmed.description: True only after the caller has confirmed the read-back of their contact details and enquiry.

consent.description: True only if the caller agreed to their details being saved for the HWS team to handle the enquiry.
